commands.commentary: Proposal-readiness executes only the existing linter. A separately reviewed precursor change lands and attests the protected-base bootstrap controller under pre-existing repository gates. That predecessor-owned controller later consumes the linked manifest outside the candidate branch, verifies the four artifact SHA-256 values, reconstructs the domain-separated sixteen-case projection and six-case preflight submanifests, and exhaustively classifies every changed path/action under the Phase 0 policy. Its atomic authority receipt activates a distinct full manifest before later phases. Six producer-faithful vectors separately reject missing alias, missing adapter, waived, not-applicable, permissive, and disabled outcomes with zero ordinary implementation work.

migrations.description: Forward-only authority-store, control-plane projection, PrincipalTable, execution ownership, skill registry, and evaluation evidence migrations with signed exhaustive inventories and fail-closed seal gates.

hold_conditions: Any migration inventory is incomplete, ambiguous, unknown, or mixed-revision
Any required authority, broker, provider, PrincipalTable, eval, or readback gate is not passing
Any release evidence expires, loses projection integrity, or observes an unresolved rollout incident
Any required CI check or branch-protection CAS is not verified active

hold_conditions_detail.migration: Seal and open remain blocked until every legacy and generation-owned row has one signed disposition.
hold_conditions_detail.security: Credential, provider, proxy, workspace, and principal scope boundaries fail closed on missing proof.
hold_conditions_detail.quality: Evaluation targets are frozen before sample zero and every declared retained case and metric target must pass.
hold_conditions_detail.release: The functionality is mandatory at open; there is no feature flag, permissive mode, waiver, or disabled state.

steps: Before any candidate or release-evidence issuance or selection depends on a staged external ruleset mutation, restore its authenticated exact preimage with an ETag compare-and-swap.
After candidate or release-evidence adoption or authority migration, keep admission held and ship a reviewed forward repair; do not disable or waive the functionality.
Preserve authority, migration, attempt, effect, incident, and evaluation history during repair.
Require the complete retained gate and fresh release evidence before reopening admission.

operator_message: Agent mission context, skill brokerage, and quality evaluation are mandatory after open. Holds require forward repair; no disable or waiver path exists.
